scope: All 47 mapped Montrachet parcels across Puligny-Montrachet and Chassagne-Montrachet independently reviewed for Tier 1 and #461. Named-area crosswalk and commune edges audited. Source-specific history, sales and reviewed notices retained; no current farmer verified. Producer research remains Tier 2.

sources.finding: Montrachet is a white Grand Cru in Puligny-Montrachet and Chassagne-Montrachet. Cadastral MONTRACHET and LE MONTRACHET remain constituents of one INAO cru, not two appellations.

Source boundaries, failed notice downloads and unsearched intervals are reported in the history coverage; none means no historical record.
Current farming remains unconfirmed for every parcel.
